name: brihadaranyaka_1_4_10
title: Aham Brahmasmi
text: In the beginning this was Self alone, in the shape of a person. He reflecting found nothing but himself. He first said, 'This is I'; therefore he became I by name.
notes: Self-recognition as the primordial act: holographic topology, EP criticality, infinite temporal depth. The I that names itself undoes the subject/object distinction.
